parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The account that you want to lock. You can lock only a single account at a time.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds lock-account --db-instance-id pgm-bp0000 --account-name testaccount --region cn-hangzhou
